name: Ceramics, glass and marble/granite processing

problems.words: Customer picks a slab and a different one gets delivered
quick_ideas: Number and photograph every slab in the yard once — makes each one identifiable
Tag the chosen slab with the customer's order the day they select it — stops it being sent elsewhere.

workzap_build.text: a slab register with photos and location, where a selected slab is reserved to the order so a different one can't be dispatched.

problems.ask_first: How are slabs identified in the yard now?
problems.free_stops: The numbering and reservation set-up is in the solution document.

problems.words: Breakage in loading and transport eats the margin
quick_ideas: Record breakage by stage for a few weeks — shows where it really happens
Photograph each load before dispatch — settles disputes at site.

workzap_build.text: a breakage log by stage with photos, totalled per route, driver and stone type.

problems.free_stops: The capture steps are in the solution document.

problems.words: Yield from each block is unknown
quick_ideas: Measure block volume in and saleable square feet out for a few blocks — gives a first yield figure
Compare suppliers on that figure — shows who gives value.

workzap_build.text: a block yield tracker by supplier and stone type.

problems.ask_first: Do you buy blocks or have your own quarry?
problems.free_stops: The yield calculation is in the solution document.

problems.words: Site measurements are wrong and stone or glass gets cut wrong
quick_ideas: Have measurements written and signed, not voice notes — removes misheard sizes
Read sizes back to the site before cutting — catches errors early.

workzap_build.text: a measurement form for site teams sent straight to the cutting floor with sketches.

problems.free_stops: The form and sign-off flow are in the solution document.

problems.words: Tiles from two batches differ in shade and the customer refuses them
quick_ideas: Fill each order from a single batch — avoids mixed shades
Label stock by batch in the yard — makes that possible.

workzap_build.text: a tile batch and shade register so orders are allocated from one batch.

problems.ask_first: Is stock labelled by batch now?
problems.free_stops: Allocation rules are in the solution document.

problems.words: Contractors take material and pay after the project
quick_ideas: List every contractor balance with its project — shows who to chase
Take an advance on new project orders — lowers your exposure.

workzap_build.text: a contractor and designer ledger with credit, ageing and reminders.

problems.ask_first: Who are your main credit customers?
problems.free_stops: Limit and reminder rules are in the solution document.

problems.words: Installation teams don't show up on the promised day
quick_ideas: Put all installation jobs for the coming week on one board — shows clashes
Confirm with each team the evening before — fewer no-shows.

workzap_build.text: an installation scheduler for teams, with customer reminders and completion photos.

problems.ask_first: How many installation teams do you run?
problems.free_stops: The scheduling set-up is in the solution document.

problems.words: Quotations for big projects take a week
quick_ideas: Keep one current price sheet per stone or tile — speeds every quote
Reuse past project quotes as a base — cuts the work.

workzap_build.text: a quotation builder using current price per sq ft, wastage allowance and installation.

problems.free_stops: The quote logic is in the solution document.

problems.words: Walk-in customers can't see our full range
quick_ideas: Photograph current yard stock — lets buyers browse before visiting
Put it on a WhatsApp catalogue — easy to share with designers.

workzap_build.text: an online and WhatsApp catalogue of current yard stock with photos, updated from the slab register.

problems.ask_first: Do you sell mostly to homeowners or contractors?
problems.free_stops: The catalogue set-up is in the solution document.

never_say: No kiln, furnace, cutting-machine, silica-dust, tempering or glass-installation safety advice.
Injuries from slabs, glass or blades: stop and point to emergency services.
No quarry or mining permit advice.
Never help mislabel origin or grade, or under-invoice exports; decline.
Never help structure designer or contractor kickbacks; no customer addresses or contractor contacts stored.

sample_reply.person: Koi solution batao. Customer yard mein slab pasand karta hai aur delivery pe koi aur slab chala jata hai.
sample_reply.pi: Ji, is ka hal bilkul mumkin hai. 1) Yard ke har slab ko ek dafa number de kar photo le lein, taake har slab ki pehchan ho. 2) Jis din customer slab chune, usi din use order ke saath tag kar dein, taake woh kahin aur na jaye. Workzap yeh aap ke liye khud-ba-khud kar sakta hai: slab register jahan chuna hua slab order se reserve ho jaye aur galat slab dispatch na ho sake. Kya main aap ke liye solution document aur quote banwa doon? Mana bhi kar sakte hain.
